facts.fact: Togo First reports the IPDCP, headed by president Bediani Belei, officially launched its activities on 28 March 2025 in Lome, some months after starting to become operational.
facts.system: Instance de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The IPDCP launched a public-awareness campaign on citizens' data rights at the 28 March 2025 event, to start on 1 April 2025, and presented its action plan; no decision or sanction is reported.
